name: argos-gestao
description: ARGOS GESTÃO 360° — ERP/CRM de clientes, contratos e cobranças da Argos Soluções

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run migrate -w server && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
